allFindings.fixSketch: Rewrite both schemas to match the controller/DB shape (id/sizeId/measurementPoint/specValue/actualValue/tolerance), and wrap the recordActualMeasurements loop in one $transaction.

allFindings.title: isActive query param validated to boolean by Zod but compared to strings in controller — explicit isActive=true returns only INACTIVE designs
allFindings.evidence: embroidery.schema.ts:75-78 transforms isActive with `val === 'true'` → boolean, and validateQuery copies the boolean back into req.query (validation.middleware.ts:57-60). Controller (embroidery.controller.ts:151, 161-163) then does `if (isActive !== 'all') where.isActive = isActive === 'true'` — boolean true === 'true' is false. Frontend sends isActive explicitly (embroidery.service.ts:34-36), including the literal 'all'.
allFindings.failureScenario: GET /api/embroidery?isActive=true → Zod boolean true → where.isActive = (true === 'true') = false → the 'Active' filter shows only deactivated designs. ?isActive=all → transformed to boolean false → 'all' branch can never match → also returns only inactive rows. Only the no-param default behaves correctly.
allFindings.fixSketch: Make the schema emit 'all' passthrough or an enum('true','false','all'), or make the controller handle boolean input (where.isActive = isActive === true || isActive === 'true'); pick one validation layer as authoritative.

allFindings.title: pendingApproval filter silently ignored: Zod transforms 'true' to boolean, controller compares to the string 'true'
allFindings.evidence: sample.schema.ts:224-227 `pendingApproval: z.string().transform(val => val === 'true')` → boolean copied into req.query by validateQuery; sample.controller.ts:357 `if (pendingApproval === 'true')` — boolean true never equals the string.
allFindings.failureScenario: GET /api/samples?pendingApproval=true (the pending-approvals dashboard view) silently returns ALL samples instead of only SUBMITTED/SENT/FEEDBACK_PENDING — wrong data with a 200, no error to notice.
allFindings.fixSketch: Compare against boolean (`if (pendingApproval === true)`) or read req.validatedQuery; standardize on the parsed types after validateQuery.

allFindings.title: minFabricWidth accepted by Zod and controller but the column does not exist on embroidery_master — update 500s, create silently drops it
allFindings.evidence: prisma/schema.prisma:2137-2166 embroidery_master has repeatWidth/repeatHeight/cutableWidth but NO minFabricWidth. embroidery.schema.ts:29/55 accepts it; updateEmbroidery sets `updateData.minFabricWidth = ...` (embroidery.controller.ts:335) → prisma.embroidery_master.update with an unknown argument throws PrismaClientValidationError. createEmbroidery destructures it (line 73) but never writes it — silent data loss; serializeEmbroidery (line 18) serializes the always-undefined field as null so the frontend never notices.
allFindings.failureScenario: User fills 'Min fabric width' on the edit form → PUT /api/embroidery/:id → 500 Unknown argument `minFabricWidth`. On create, the value is accepted with 201 and silently discarded.
allFindings.fixSketch: Either add a minFabricWidth Decimal? column via migration, or remove the field from schema, controller, and serializer.

allFindings.title: sampleNumber has no unique constraint and is generated from an isActive-filtered count — hard deletes and races silently mint duplicate sample numbers
allFindings.evidence: prisma/schema.prisma:1461+1496: sampleNumber is @@index'd, not @@unique. generateSampleNumber (sample.controller.ts:38-48) uses count(where isActive:true)+1, while deleteSample (line 701) HARD-deletes rows and FIT versioning (lines 151-157, 980-987) uses a count WITHOUT the isActive filter — two divergent computations of the same sequence (also F5). embroidery_master.embroideryCode is likewise only @@index'd (schema.prisma:2163) with a read-then-create findFirst generator (embroidery.controller.ts:33-57).
allFindings.failureScenario: Create PP samples 1-3, delete #3, create another → count=2 → seq 0003 again → two rows share sampleNumber 'PP-202607-0003' with no DB error; downstream lookups by sampleNumber pick an arbitrary row. Two concurrent creates produce the same number the same way. FIT: delete v2, create revision → duplicate 'FIT-STY-v2'.
allFindings.fixSketch: Add @@unique on samples.sampleNumber and embroidery_master.embroideryCode, generate inside a retry-on-P2002 loop, and derive the sequence from the max existing number rather than a row count.

allFindings.title: Admin-override audit log runs after sample creation, outside any transaction, and always throws because required toStage is never passed
allFindings.evidence: createSample calls logOverride AFTER prisma.samples.create with no toStage (sample.controller.ts:253-260). productionBlockingValidationService.logOverride passes `toStage: data.toStage!` (productionBlockingValidation.service.ts:757) into stage_transition_overrides where toStage is a REQUIRED ProductionStage (schema.prisma:7315). undefined → PrismaClientValidationError.
allFindings.failureScenario: Admin creates a PP sample with adminOverride=true + reason → sample row is committed, then logOverride throws → user gets 500 'creation failed' though the sample exists (likely retried → duplicate), and the mandatory override audit record is never written.
allFindings.fixSketch: Make toStage nullable for SAMPLE_CREATION block types (or pass a sentinel), and wrap sample create + override log in one $transaction.

allFindings.title: Embroidery costing math done on raw JS floats (parseFloat + unguarded divide) instead of currency.ts helpers
allFindings.evidence: receive(): `embroideryCostPerMeter = data.actualCost / data.quantityReceived` (line 248-250, unguarded divide), `totalCostPerMeter = fabricCostPerMeter + embroideryCostPerMeter` (line 251) — parseFloat'd Decimals recombined as floats and stored into weightedAvgCost/purchaseCost (lines 269-270) and transaction totals (283, 292-296). Same float pattern in sendOut (lines 122-124) and cancelSendOut (494-497). backend/src/utils/currency.ts (roundToCent, guarded divide, weighted average) is imported nowhere in this file.
allFindings.failureScenario: actualCost=1000 over quantityReceived=3 → 333.3333333333 float propagated into weightedAvgCost and totalValue; Decimal(10,2) truncation then makes balanceAfter*cost ≠ valueAfter, so the stock ledger's value column drifts a paisa per receipt and never reconciles. (quantityReceived=0 is only accidentally blocked by the controller's truthiness check, which also blocks legitimate 0-received damage-only receipts.)
allFindings.fixSketch: Route the per-meter cost and totals through decimal.js helpers in utils/currency.ts (guarded divide + roundToCent) and keep Decimal types end-to-end.

allFindings.title: Send-out list query schema validates a status enum and filter keys that don't exist in the model — filtering by any real status returns 400
allFindings.evidence: embroideryStockQuerySchema:91 `status: z.enum(['PENDING','PARTIAL','COMPLETED','CANCELLED'])`, but embroidery_send_out.status values written by the service are SENT / IN_PROGRESS / PARTIALLY_RECEIVED / RECEIVED / CANCELLED (embroidery-stock.service.ts:159, 310, 525; schema.prisma:2186 default 'SENT'). The schema also validates processorId/orderId which the controller never reads, while the real filters (embroideryId, supplierId, forStyleId, forOrderId — embroidery-stock.controller.ts:122) only survive because validateQuery doesn't remove unknown keys from req.query.
allFindings.failureScenario: GET /api/embroidery-stock/send-outs?status=SENT (frontend EmbroiderySendOutQueryParams passes real statuses) → 400 'Invalid query parameters'; only status=CANCELLED works. Date filters with YYYY-MM-DD → 400 via .datetime().
allFindings.fixSketch: Align the enum with actual statuses, add the real filter keys, use z.coerce.date() for fromDate/toDate.

allFindings.title: Two divergent definitions of the sample-approval gate: stage validation passes when NO sample exists, while creation gates and checkApprovalGate require an approved sample
allFindings.evidence: validateFitSampleForStage (line 100-102) and validateSizeSetSampleForStage (line 152-154) return not-blocked when no sample of the type exists, so the 'FIT blocks printing/dyeing' and 'Size Set blocks cutting' invariants are void if nobody ever creates the sample. Meanwhile validatePPSampleCreation/validateSizeSetSampleCreation (lines 692-743) and checkApprovalGate (sample.controller.ts:1118-1156, canCreateWorkOrder = sizeSetApproved > 0) require an approved sample to exist. The same invariant is computed two contradictory ways.
allFindings.failureScenario: A style with no SIZE_SET_SAMPLE row at all: checkApprovalGate says canCreateWorkOrder=false, but validateStageTransition happily lets the work order move to IN_CUTTING — the stage gate the samples module exists to enforce is bypassed simply by never creating the sample.
allFindings.fixSketch: Decide the invariant once: either stage gates require an approved sample to exist for gated stages (consistent with checkApprovalGate), or explicitly document/flag styles as 'sample-exempt' and have both code paths honor that flag.

allFindings.title: sendOut availability check is read-then-decrement with no conditional guard — concurrent send-outs drive fabric_stock negative
allFindings.evidence: Inside the $transaction: availableQty read at line 87, compared at 88, then a blind `quantityAvailable: { decrement: data.quantitySent }` at 111-119. No `updateMany({ where: { quantityAvailable: { gte: qty } } })` guard and no row lock, so two transactions can both read 100, both pass, both decrement.
allFindings.failureScenario: Two users send out 80m from the same 100m lot simultaneously → both pass the check → quantityAvailable = -60, stock_levels double-decremented; downstream 'available > 0' queries hide the lot while the ledger shows phantom negative stock.
allFindings.fixSketch: Use a conditional updateMany with quantityAvailable >= quantitySent in the where clause (throw if count===0), or SELECT ... FOR UPDATE the stock row first.

allFindings.title: z.string().datetime() on all sample/embroidery-stock date fields rejects YYYY-MM-DD from <input type=date>
allFindings.evidence: sample.schema.ts:45-46 (requestDate/requiredDate — requiredDate is REQUIRED), :104-113 (update dates), :169, :180, :196, :222-223 (fromDate/toDate); embroideryStock.schema.ts:42-43, 92-93. The repo guardrail explicitly flags this class ('rejects YYYY-MM-DD from <input type=date>'; fix = z.coerce.date()).
allFindings.failureScenario: Any client sending '2026-07-21' (plain date-picker value) for requiredDate → 400 on sample creation even after the enum drift is fixed; date-range filters 400 the list pages.
allFindings.fixSketch: Replace z.string().datetime() with z.coerce.date() across sample.schema.ts and embroideryStock.schema.ts (per the smart-check guardrail's prescribed fix).

allFindings.title: Lace lab dip POST /, PUT /:id and POST /:id/status have no validateBody — no Zod schema exists for the module
allFindings.evidence: laceLabDip.routes.ts:34, 63, 78 wire controllers with only validateParams; there is no laceLabDip schema file in backend/src/schemas/. Controller relies on manual truthiness checks (laceLabDip.controller.ts:26) and parseFloat on unvalidated strings (:35, 114-115 — parseFloat('abc') → NaN passed to Decimal → 500).
allFindings.failureScenario: POST /api/lace-lab-dips with sampleQuantity='abc' → NaN → Prisma Decimal error 500 instead of a 400; unknown/extra fields flow into the controller unchecked. Violates the route-validation guardrail (likely baselined).
allFindings.fixSketch: Add backend/src/schemas/laceLabDip.schema.ts (create/update/status schemas matching the controller's destructuring, status as z.nativeEnum(LaceLabDipStatus)) and wire validateBody.

allFindings.title: updateEmbroidery: nullable numeric fields hit parseFloat(null) → NaN → Prisma 500 when a client clears them
allFindings.evidence: updateEmbroiderySchema allows null for costPerMeter/cutableWidth (embroidery.schema.ts:57, 61), but the controller does `if (costPerMeter !== undefined) updateData.costPerMeter = parseFloat(costPerMeter)` (line 337) and `cutableWidth = parseFloat(cutableWidth)` (line 336) with no null branch — parseFloat(null) is NaN. Other fields (stitchCount etc.) have the `x ? parse : null` guard; these two don't.
allFindings.failureScenario: User clears the cost field → PUT sends costPerMeter: null → passes Zod → updateData.costPerMeter = NaN → Prisma Decimal conversion error → 500; also the truthy guards elsewhere turn legitimate 0 into null (e.g. leadTimeDays 0).
allFindings.fixSketch: Guard nulls: `costPerMeter === null ? null : parseFloat(costPerMeter)` (and same for cutableWidth), or accept z.number() and drop parseFloat entirely since Zod already coerces the type.

allFindings.title: Schemas advertise fields the controllers silently discard: receivedBy/condition on receipt, remarks/changesToMake on revision
allFindings.evidence: recordReceiptSchema:179-184 accepts receivedBy and condition, but recordReceipt (sample.controller.ts:863-901) destructures only receivedDate/remarks — receivedBy/condition validated then dropped. createRevisionSchema:205-208 accepts remarks/changesToMake; createRevision (sample.controller.ts:955-1040) reads neither and hardcodes remarks to 'Revision of ...'.
allFindings.failureScenario: A client records who received the sample and its condition → 200 OK, data never persisted anywhere — silent data loss the caller cannot detect; revision notes ('changesToMake') vanish the same way.
allFindings.fixSketch: Either persist the fields (map to columns) or delete them from the schemas so clients get honest 400s/type errors instead of silent drops.
